title: demo.story
description: A four-stage pipeline strip: a track with one node per stage, a marker on the current stage, and a caption (a built-in text mounted with ctx.mount) that changes with the stage. Spike component for the custom-component contract.

stage.description: The current stage, 0 to 3. Nodes up to it are filled, the marker sits on it and the caption describes it. Drive it from the slide with `advance`.
